The image shows a single plant leaf against a light-colored, textured background. The leaf is discolored, appearing greenish-brown and desiccated. It is covered with numerous small, irregular, dark brown to black spots. These spots are scattered across the leaf surface. Comparing this to the provided descriptions, the symptoms most closely match those of Anthracnose, which is described as starting with "small, black, and irregular" spots on leaves that "expanding into large dead areas that dry and fall out." The other descriptions do not fit as well. Die_Back involves twigs dying back and leaves rolling and turning brown. Sooty_Mould appears as a superficial dark fungal deposit, which is different from the distinct spots seen here. There is no information provided for Powdery_Mildew. Therefore, Anthracnose is the most likely diagnosis.
